cases.name: GP Service Info (generic)
cases.notes: Returns service metadata and the published task list projected from the built-in IProcessCatalog. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: Task Metadata
cases.notes: Returns task name, display name, parameters, and choice lists. Served via PrintingTools endpoints.

cases.name: Execute Task (sync)
cases.endpoint: GET /rest/services/Utilities/PrintingTools/GPServer/Export Web Map Task/execute; POST /rest/services/Utilities/PrintingTools/GPServer/Export Web Map Task/execute
cases.notes: Synchronous map export returning image bytes. PrintingTools-specific implementation.

cases.name: Job Status
cases.notes: Job status polling with result parameter URL. PrintingTools-specific implementation.

cases.name: Job Results
cases.notes: Single-parameter result access (Output_File only). PrintingTools-specific implementation.

cases.name: Submit Job (async)
cases.endpoint: GET /rest/services/Utilities/PrintingTools/GPServer/Export Web Map Task/submitJob; POST /rest/services/Utilities/PrintingTools/GPServer/Export Web Map Task/submitJob
cases.notes: Asynchronous map export job submission. PrintingTools-specific implementation.

cases.name: Template Listing (sync)
cases.notes: Returns available layout templates. PrintingTools-specific implementation.

cases.name: GP Task Info (generic)
cases.notes: Returns task metadata projected from the built-in IProcessCatalog, including parameter descriptions and Esri data types. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: Execute Task (generic, sync)
cases.notes: Runs sync-eligible (deterministic single-geometry geometry.* / conversion.geometry-format) tasks inline through the same canonical job runtime as submitJob and returns the Esri execute envelope (results + messages). Async-only tasks return a 400 capability message pointing at submitJob. Honors env:outSR for reprojectable geometry outputs (unlike submitJob, which rejects env:* controls). Implemented in #1660.

cases.name: Jobs List
cases.notes: Lists submitted/running/completed/failed jobs for a task, newest first, with opaque cursor paging. Job/Read authorization and per-job ownership are enforced in the shared job service before any job is surfaced.

cases.name: Job Status (generic)
cases.notes: Job status polling with route binding validation. Maps ExecutionJobRecord to Esri status. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: Cancel Job (generic)
cases.notes: Job cancellation with route binding validation. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: Job Results (generic)
cases.notes: Per-output result access with route binding validation. Result storage pending execution engine. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: Submit Job (generic)
cases.notes: Resolves the published task name against the built-in IProcessCatalog, validates inputs, persists GPServer route metadata, and returns an Esri job envelope. Implemented in #723.

cases.name: published generic task names currently mirror internal built-in process IDs (for example geometry.buffer)
GP environment controls (env:*) are rejected with 400 until engine support is available; context is preserved as protocol metadata but not interpreted yet
per-parameter result retrieval route registered but actual output retrieval pending execution-engine/result-storage support
